release_status.name: release_status
release_status.value: ("learning"."content_releases"."status"='draft' and "learning"."content_releases"."published_at" is null and "learning"."content_releases"."publisher" is null) or ("learning"."content_releases"."status"='published' and "learning"."content_releases"."published_at" is not null and length(trim("learning"."content_releases"."publisher"))>0 and "learning"."content_releases"."publisher" is not null)

import_finished.name: import_finished
import_finished.value: ("learning"."import_runs"."status"='running' and "learning"."import_runs"."finished_at" is null) or ("learning"."import_runs"."status"<>'running' and "learning"."import_runs"."finished_at" is not null)

level_scheme.name: level_scheme
level_scheme.value: ("learning"."level_assignments"."scheme"='jlpt-current-approx' and "learning"."level_assignments"."level" between 1 and 5) or ("learning"."level_assignments"."scheme"='jlpt-pre2010' and "learning"."level_assignments"."level" between 1 and 4)

session_state.name: session_state
session_state.value: ("learning"."quiz_sessions"."status" = 'active' and "learning"."quiz_sessions"."score" is null and "learning"."quiz_sessions"."completed_at" is null) or ("learning"."quiz_sessions"."status" = 'completed' and "learning"."quiz_sessions"."score" is not null and "learning"."quiz_sessions"."score" between 0 and "learning"."quiz_sessions"."total" and "learning"."quiz_sessions"."completed_at" is not null)
